svg.text: C2 Containers: the dataspace authority's side
The issuer the dataspace authority runs, one per dataspace, what it keeps, and the bundle it builds offline
Builds and signs one bundle version, checks it as a connector
Its DID, its service URL, the public bundle
What it can issue, for example
Signs every credential and status list: the
Trust the issuer's DID for their credentials
Optional: receives traces and metrics when
Runs it for each new version of the rules
A store: database, folder or file
Calls; the arrow points from the caller

C4 model, level 2. The dataspace authority runs one issuer for all participants, never on a participant's host. The issuer key is the dataspace's root of trust (R-20); the bundle key stays offline, and the issuer holds only its public part (DEPLOYING, section 7). The management port also answers the health
checks, without the API key; traces and metrics go to the authority's observability backend only when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set (ADR 0023).
